PLAN_MODE_CLAUSE: Don't enter plan mode unless asked to plan.
TRACK_CHUNK: Track each chunk with the todo list (TodoWrite).
MATCH_SPECIALIST: Specialist knowledge loads as Agent Skills (`~/.zcode/skills/`) when their description matches the work, or explicitly as slash commands (e.g. `/python`, `/go`, `/review`, `/ship`).
COLLAB_SECTION: - Give each invocation a self-contained instruction (paths, constraints, expected output), and run `/review` before finishing. Tightly coupled work stays sequential.
